app.title: From a routine stroke scan to its network-level consequences
app.subtitle: Upload a lesion and run reproducible, versioned analysis pipelines on it. Every result carries the exact tools, parameters and reference data that produced it.
app.loginPrompt: Sign in with the account provided by the platform administrator.
app.featureLesion: A CT scan with its lesion mask, or a mask already in MNI space, checked and brought to standard space.
app.featureNetwork: Lesion network mapping and tract-wise disconnection against normative connectomes.
app.featureProvenance: Versioned steps, pinned reference data and a full provenance record for every run.
app.researchOnly: Research use only. Not for clinical decisions.

wizard.title: New case
wizard.sameCase: The files of this case are reused; nothing is uploaded again. Choose the analysis for the new run.
wizard.privacy: A case stores only a platform-generated label, an optional sex and an age band. Do not enter names or identifiers. File names are not stored.

modeHint.ct: Upload a CT scan and a lesion mask drawn on it. The pipeline normalises the lesion to MNI space.
modeHint.mni: Upload a lesion mask that is already in MNI space; normalisation is skipped.

wizard.ageHint: Only the age band is stored. The exact age is never sent to the server.
wizard.locked: The case has been created; these values can no longer be changed here.
wizard.filesHint: Select the files for this mode (.nii.gz only).

example.hint: A synthetic lesion mask for trying the platform. It is not patient data and is marked as a synthetic example on the run and in the report.

origin.invalid: Use only letters, digits and . _ + - (up to 64 characters). Do not enter names or identifiers.
origin.hint: This is shown on the run page and in the report as declared by the user. The platform cannot verify it. Enter only a tool name and version, never names or identifiers.
